description: A Python script that reads code snippets from a file, checks their formatting using the 'black' code formatter, and outputs the results indicating whether the code snippets are correctly formatted, need updates, or if errors occurred.

methods.name: check_code_snippet(code_snippet: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given code snippet is formatted according to 'black'. Returns status and optionally reformatted code.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that loads code snippets from a specified file, processes each snippet with 'check_code_snippet', and outputs the results.
